newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS - Normandy says new mines to help net.
newsitem.headline: RTRS - Normandy says new mines to help net.

text.p: Gold and base metals miner Normandy Mining Ltd said the opening of new low cost mines over the next year should help improve its overall operating costs and financial results.

Chairman Robert Champion de Crespigny told the annual meeting that the group planned to start production at the Ovacik gold project in western Turkey and the Vera-Nancy and Callie underground mines in Australia over the next year.
"Each of these will be high grade, low cost operations that will have a significant impact on our overall operating costs and on the company's bottom line," de Crespigny said.
